title: Use only registered agricultural chemical products
what: Use or deal with a chemical product only if it is registered and used as its approved label allows, or under a permit.

laws.title: Agricultural and Veterinary Chemicals (Control of Use) Act 1995 (Tas)

sources.title: Agricultural and Veterinary Chemicals (Control of Use) Act 1995 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not use or deal with a chemical product unless – (a) it is registered under the Code and it is used or dealt with in accordance with a label approved under the Code in relation to that chemical product
